name: Numbered list that gets struck off
description: A big condensed black title ('SAME PROBLEM.') above up to four white numbered row cards (black number circle, bold uppercase title, small grey mono subtitle) that stagger in; then each row in turn is struck through with an orange line, gets an orange ✗ badge and greys out; or gets an orange ✓ badge instead. One row can be spared and highlighted with an orange outline and a ✓.
use_when: Lines that sum up or rule out options, attempts or myths ('all three have the same problem', 'none of these work', 'I tried everything'), a checklist being ticked off ('you need three things'), or narrowing many choices down to the one that is left.

title.help: headline above the list, e.g. 'Same problem.'; fitted to one line

items.help: [{title, sub}] rows in order; title up to ~18 characters, sub is an optional short mono note (~30 characters)

mode.help: 'strike' (each row struck + orange ✗, greyed), 'check' (each row gets an orange ✓) or 'none' (just the list)

keep.help: 0-based index of one row that is NOT struck and gets highlighted (orange outline + ✓), e.g. 2 for the third row; unset for none
